answer: Conductance cut detection bounds Sybil influence by measuring the Cheeger ratio phi(S) = |E(S, V\S)| / min(vol(S), vol(V\S)) across subgraphs of the bilateral attestation graph before distributing rewards. An honest neighborhood sits on a broad mesa of cross-community edges with high conductance toward the trusted summit, whereas a Sybil ring of k self-vouching clones forms an isolated knoll with internal volume O(k^2) tied to honest peers by only g attack edges, driving phi(S) to O(g/k^2) and capping the whole cluster's payout at O(g).
